Rooms.Name: Muddy Path
Rooms.Description:
This section of the path is slowly being drowned by the nearby swamp to the
south, which is creeping slowly inland. Several caved-in buildings sprawl here,
torn apart both by battle and the elements. There is a battered sign here.

Exits.Description: The path looks drier here.
A broken road leading southward into the marsh.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: WARNING:  The Murky Swamps to the south are very dangerous.

Rooms.Name: Swamp's Edge
Rooms.Description:
Briars and marsh plants stick to your boots and clothes, and clouds cover
the skies above the murky marsh, leaving the path before you dark and sinister.
You see some disturbances in the marsh, but after a few strangled screams, the
sounds stop.

Exits.Description: To the east lies a series of bogs and shallows that look rather threatening.
You notice a large hill rising out of the marsh to the south.

Rooms.Name: Marshy Forest
Rooms.Description:
This area is by no means a forest, but for those who dwell in these sparse
trees it is one. Occasionally you see a whole humanoid form floating face down
in the water, but mostly you only find pieces. You hear a loud bellow in the
distance. And feel fear creep into your heart.

Exits.Description: Eastward is the thick bog of ooze...

Westward lies the remnants of a broken and shattered roadway being swallowed
by the marsh.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see severed limbs and spongy intestines.

He looks mangled and shredded.  You see one large gash mark that looks
like it came from the claw of some huge beast.

Rooms.Name: On a hill
Rooms.Description:
You stand atop a hill on the northwestern side of the evil swamp. Dark
clouds whip around you and the wind raises its voice and assails you.

Exits.Description: To the north lies a damp broken roadway.
A dark pool congeals to the east.
A gloomy path leads down the hill into the swamp.

Rooms.Name: An Oozing Bog
Rooms.Description:
You stand in an oozing quagmire. A creaking beat fills the air, accompanied
by groans and soughing of the air. Several large winged beasts flap over you
and send chilling glares your way. You feel out of place, and feel that the
occupants of this realm will soon have you for a feast.

Exits.Description: Eastward lies a horde of disgusting looking monsters.
Westward lies a marshy area.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a large creature, possibly a demon, flapping heavily above you.

Rooms.Name: An Oozing Bog
Rooms.Description:
The ground here is soft and oozing. You feel slimy water seeping into your
boots. Better stop and check for leeches when you get out of here.

Exits.Description: You see a large tree limb that looks easily moved.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The limb looks like it is attached to a trap door in the ground.

Rooms.Name: Swamp Thing's Lair
Rooms.Description:
A horrible swamp thing resides here. Mutilated corpses suffuse the air with
the overwhelming stench of putrid flesh.

Exits.Description: A pool of quick sand lies to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You notice a note on one of the corpses reading:  'Best ye forget the temple,
it is not for the likes of you...'

Rooms.Name: Pool of Quick Sand
Rooms.Description:
You stand by a large oozing pool of quick sand. Luckily only a complete
klutz could not avoid it. Dancing lights fly about you and one seems to be
taunting you towards the pool.

Exits.Description: The swamp thing's lair.
A murky bog.
A dark pool lies to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks deadly to the foolish.
From the stories you have heard, you recognize them as will-o-wisps.

Rooms.Name: A Dark Pool
Rooms.Description:
You stand beside a large dark pond. The water boils not with heat, but with
motion, as if it is alive. A creaking beat pulses through the air, leaving you
with a cold sweat and fear in your heart.

Exits.Description: A large pool of quicksand lies to the east.
You see a cloud of darkness to the south.
A hill rises out of the swamp to the east.

Rooms.Name: Gloomy Path Through the Marsh
Rooms.Description:
To the north lies a hill, shrouded in dark clouds, and to the south lies a
huge patch of vegetation. You sense an evil presence and notice a beast flying
overhead to the south east, towards what looks to be a huge fortress, half
buried in the marsh.

Exits.Description: To the north a hill protrudes from the marshes.
To the south a huge mass of vegetation seems to quiver with life.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is surrounded by walls nearly 20 meters high.  In a tall tower on the
northeast side, a window glows blue with magical energy.
It looks to be a demon of some foul breed.
The clouds look dark and foreboding.

Rooms.Name: Cloud of Darkness
Rooms.Description:
As you travel through this cloud of darkness, a fear such as you have never
known before assails you.

Exits.Description: A dark pool lies to the north.
An obelisk lies to the south.

Rooms.Name: Near Vegetation from Hell
Rooms.Description:
You stand near some of the strangest plant life you have ever seen, a
mixture of tumescent vegetables, evil-smelling fruit trees, and malignant
ferns.

Exits.Description: To the north is a gloomy path through the marsh.
Eastward is a large, black stone monolith.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They look rather violent, and snap at you when you come near.

Rooms.Name: By the Monolith
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near a monolith which protrudes some 20 feet from the marsh
into the air. Its black obsidian surface shines darkly in the strange, almost
unearthly light that enters through the clouds above.

Exits.Description: To the north is a cloud of darkest evil.
Eastward lies a murky bog.
Near Vegetation from Hell.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This huge monolith resembles nothing you have ever seen before.
You have a strong feeling not to go within.

Rooms.Name: Murky Bog
Rooms.Description:
A murky bog surrounds you. To the east a black monolith juts forth from the
ground. Far to the north lies a huge pool of quicksand. Snarls can be heard
echoing as if from a great distance.

Exits.Description: To the north lies a huge pool of quicksand.
To the east the marsh turns into a small lake.
Westward a large monolith awaits adventurers.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a huge obsidian stone block stuck in the marsh.

Rooms.Name: Northern Lake Side
Rooms.Description:
Floating on this boiling lake is not what you would consider an enjoyable
experience. Many a creature bumps the bottom of your boat, and glares at you
through unblinking eyes from the waters below. The southern portion of the lake
looks calm and serene compared to this wild place.

Exits.Description: The southern portion of the lake lies to the south.
To the west lies a murky bog.

Rooms.Name: Southern Lake Side
Rooms.Description:
You are floating on a calm section of blue crystal water. You feel much more
at ease then you were before in this area. Then a wave of fear passes over you.
You are not alone.

Exits.Description: Northern lake side.
To the west is a beach where your boat can land.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The way to the north seems to be impassable, due to the rough water and
strange wild life.

Rooms.Name: Beach
Rooms.Description:
You are on a sandy shore. Marsh life creeps across the surface. To the
west you can see a strange stone building.

Exits.Description: To the east lies the southern portion of a small lake.

Rooms.Name: Before the Stone Building
Rooms.Description:
You stand before an old stone building. The building looks like it have been
very beautiful. Now the only thing that remains is a dark hollow shell. Green
vegetation have taken over residence in the ruins.

Exits.Description: To the east is a marshy beach.

Mobs.Name: troll
Mobs.LongDescription: A swamp troll charges towards you.
Mobs.Description:
This huge behemoth towers to a height of 15 feet.  He sneers at you 
as he approaches and raises two black taloned claws to strike you.

Mobs.Name: troll
Mobs.LongDescription: A green troll attempts to get a hold on you.
Mobs.Description:
This big troll towers several feet over you.  He has a large spear
which he seems to ply with utmost prowess.  He jabs his spear at you
and cackles with glee.

Mobs.Name: ogre
Mobs.LongDescription: An ogre stands here getting ready to beat in your face.
Mobs.Description: This mean bastard looks like he could tear you limb from limb.

Mobs.Name: thing
Mobs.LongDescription: the Swamp Thing shambles about here.  It seems hungry.
Mobs.Description: The Swamp Thing has huge fists, which look like they could pound you flat.

Mobs.Name: gnoll
Mobs.LongDescription: There is a mean looking gnoll here.
Mobs.Description: The Gnoll seems annoyed at your presence.

Mobs.Name: beast
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge hairy beast shambles towards you with death in his eyes.
Mobs.Description:
This huge beast stands about 20 feet in height and has huge green clawed
appendages.

Mobs.Name: beast
Mobs.LongDescription: A rather small beast cringes in terror as it notices you.
Mobs.Description:
This rather small beast looks like you could take it out with a single
sword blow.

Mobs.Name: will will-o-wisp
Mobs.LongDescription: A Will-O-Wisp darts here and there, making fun of you.
Mobs.Description:
This strange little creature seems very hard to keep your eyes on.
You stare as hard as you can at the glowing ball of floating light and
are just able to notice a small pair of glowing eyes.

Mobs.Name: snake anaconda
Mobs.LongDescription: A monstrous snake slithers towards you, thinking 'breakfast'.
Mobs.Description: This 10 meter anaconda looks rather hungry.

Mobs.Name: snake python
Mobs.LongDescription: A rather large python rests in a coil here.
Mobs.Description: It's the largest Amazon python you have ever seen.

Mobs.Name: hag
Mobs.Description:
Yech!  She manages to make even Smurfette look attractive.  That's ok,
because she thinks you stink too, and she's about to do something about it.

Mobs.Name: slaad
Mobs.LongDescription: A Death Slaad is standing here distraught.  He seems lost.
Mobs.Description:
This dark apparition stands a meager 13 feet in height.  Even in the dim
swamp light, the blade of his scythe gleams.

Mobs.Name: wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: A marsh wolf sniffs the ground has followed your scent.
Mobs.Description:
This wolf looks plump.  She probably ate a friend or two of yours who came
into the marsh.

Mobs.Name: mound shambling
Mobs.LongDescription: A heap of garbage shambles towards you.
Mobs.Description: This grotesque pile of plant matter fills you with utmost horror.

Mobs.Name: shaman orc
Mobs.LongDescription: An orc shaman stands before you holding a staff and wearing robes.
Mobs.Description:
This old orc has an array of bones stuck in his hair and strange symbols
painted on his face and hands.

Mobs.Name: giant
Mobs.LongDescription: A marsh giant stomps towards you.
Mobs.Description: This huge monster of a man has green gnarly teeth and a BIG stick.

Mobs.Name: gargoyle
Mobs.LongDescription: A large gargoyle lands next to you, baring his fangs at you.
Mobs.Description: This creepy fellow looks like he could use you as a meal.

Objects.Name: horned helmet
Objects.Description: A wicked looking horned helmet lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: These horns appear to be made of adamantite.

Objects.Name: chain mail chainmail
Objects.Description: An old suit of chainmail lies here, corroded by the marsh.

Objects.Name: scythe
Objects.Description: An evil, wicked-looking scythe lies in the shadows.

Objects.Name: green potion
Objects.Description: A murky green potion lies here in the mud.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks really disgusting and doesn't smell very nice either.

Objects.Name: spear jagged
Objects.Description: A jagged spear has been left here.
